acceptanceCriteria: A1: Workspace package metadata and Cargo.lock consistently identify v0.2.30.
A2: Release, versioning, distribution, and tri-language parity documents identify v0.2.30 and preserve v0.2.29 as N-1 where applicable.
A3: Format, clippy, workspace tests, documentation, conformance, release policy, and version consistency checks pass.
A4: The reviewed PR is merged, the public v0.2.30 Release tag and immutable artifacts are published, and release identity is recorded.
A5: Installed public v0.2.30 inspect/status/doctor/agent doctor pass, and isolated adopter/upgrade acceptance receipts bind the published runtime identity and clean temporary roots.
goal: Establish the v0.2.30 release baseline, publish it, install the released binary, and prove adopter and upgrade acceptance from a clean environment.
intent: Publish v0.2.30 from the merged default branch and verify the immutable public artifact with installed-runtime acceptance.
outOfScope: Rewriting prior release truth or historical archive bytes
Changing Runtime governance semantics unrelated to release versioning
Modifying global Agent or MCP configuration

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cargo metadata, Cargo.lock, release documentation, and tri-language parity identify v0.2.30 with v0.2.29 as N-1.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version consistency, documentation acceptance, parity, format, clippy, and workspace tests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed merge commit, v0.2.30 tag, release manifest, archive checksums, and binary digest are one immutable identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the release workflow and record tag, manifest, archive, binary, and provider Release evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The downloaded v0.2.30 binary governs a fresh adopter repository, preserving first-adopter-smoke as not_ready and completing the Work Item lifecycle.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public adopter acceptance harness with isolated HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, and CARGO_HOME.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The v0.2.29 adopter upgrades to v0.2.30 with migration/compatibility evidence, and all temporary roots are cleaned without changing Release truth.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public upgrade acceptance harness and verify cleanup manifests and receipts.
